profile.summary: The developer profile for azatoth indicates limited direct contributions to modern JavaScript frameworks or paradigms. Their primary expertise appears centered around legacy JavaScript systems, specifically the jQuery ecosystem. The contributions are predominantly focused on build tooling (Makefile changes, Git submodule management) rather than core JavaScript development. While there is evidence of unit testing experience (likely using QUnit), no modern testing frameworks or advanced JavaScript concepts are visible. The developer shows proficiency in maintaining legacy JavaScript codebases and build processes but lacks experience with contemporary JavaScript practices, frameworks, or tooling. This profile suggests a Junior-level developer with specialized knowledge in jQuery and legacy build systems rather than broader JavaScript expertise.
